messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Equinox wants a joint POC. EU-only, Okta SAML, SCIM, and an estimated demo cost. can we scope?
Ethan (Partner Eng): their flow: upload legal docs -> embeddings -> semantic search + redaction. demo traffic small, but procurement cares about data residency.
Jules (SE): quick Qs: avg doc size? peak search rps? will they want Splunk log forwarding?
Ethan (Partner Eng): avg 60KB, peak 8 rps, yes they asked for logs to be exported to their Splunk in EU.
Nora (CloudOps): Dedicated in eu-west is best for EU-only and Splunk forwarding. lead time ~5 business days; Private deploy 10-12 days. need their subscription ID and CIDR.
Pri (AE): pricing ask: I need ballpark hosted vs dedicated for procurement. also include prorated cost for a 3-week demo.
Jules (SE): rough: hosted POC metered ~$120/day for this workload; dedicated 1-GPU pool ~$2.2k/mo -> prorate 3 weeks ~$1.6k + egress. will add note about latency variance.
SecBot: checklist: DPA required, SOC2 summary attached, missing: vendor risk assessment and encryption diagram. CMEK supported.
Maya (Partnerships): action items: Jules draft runbook (SAML snippet + ingest sample), Nora prepare infra ticket template, Pri prepare one-pager cost options. I'll send to Equinox by EOD tomorrow.
Ethan (Partner Eng): sample SAML attrs for Okta: email, name, groups. sample ingest CLI ready.
Jules (SE): sample ingest: ```bash
curl -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer POC" -F file=@doc.pdf
```
Nora (CloudOps): note: expedited dedicated provisioning needs infra-ops approval; flag here if they need start <5 days.
Pri (AE): Equinox aiming to start in 12 business days which should be fine. I'll wait for the one-pager and quote. :thumbsup:
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. SecBot attach security pack and DPA template when ready. closing loop tomorrow.
SecBot: security_pack_attached=false, dpa_received=false, vendor_risk_assessed=false
